settings.label: Corruption spreads
settings.description: Let the Corruption spread into nearby blocks. Spreading only happens in hardmode.

settings.label: Crimson spreads
settings.description: Let the Crimson spread into nearby blocks. Spreading only happens in hardmode.

settings.label: Hallow spreads
settings.description: Let the Hallow spread into nearby blocks. Spreading only happens in hardmode.

settings.label: Block hardmode
settings.description: Stop the world from entering hardmode when the Wall of Flesh dies.

settings.label: Time of day
settings.description: Keep it day or night all the time, or let time pass normally.

settings.label: Always Christmas
settings.description: Christmas items and events all year.

settings.label: Always Halloween
settings.description: Halloween items and events all year.

settings.label: No tombstones
settings.description: Players leave no tombstone when they die.

settings.label: No clown bombs
settings.description: Clowns cannot throw bombs that break blocks.

settings.label: No snowball projectiles
settings.description: Stop the snowballs thrown during the Frost Legion.

settings.label: No Skeletron Prime bombs
settings.description: Skeletron Prime's bombs do not break blocks.

settings.label: No Dungeon Guardian
settings.description: Players entering the Dungeon early are sent to spawn instead of meeting the Guardian.

settings.label: Bomb radius
settings.description: How many tiles a bomb's explosion reaches.

settings.label: Ice Rod blocks
settings.description: Let players place the ice blocks made by the Ice Rod.

settings.label: World name
settings.description: The name a new world gets when it is created.

settings.label: New world size
settings.description: The size of the world created when none exists yet.

settings.label: Seed
settings.description: The seed a new world is generated from. Secret seeds such as 'for the worthy' work here too.

settings.label: New world difficulty
settings.description: The game mode of a new world.

settings.label: Maximum players
settings.description: How many players can be online at once.

settings.label: Maximum players
settings.description: How many players can be online at once.

settings.label: Reserved slots
settings.description: Extra slots only players with the reserved-slot permission can use when the server is full.

settings.label: Message of the day
settings.description: Shown to players when they join.

settings.label: Server password
settings.description: Players need this to join. Leave empty for none.

settings.label: Server password
settings.description: Players need this to join. Leave empty for none.

settings.label: Server name
settings.description: Shown instead of the world name when 'Use server name' is on.

settings.label: Use server name
settings.description: Show the server name instead of the world name.

settings.label: Language
settings.description: The language of server messages.

settings.label: Whitelist
settings.description: Only addresses on tshock/whitelist.txt can join.

settings.label: Require an account
settings.description: Players must log in to an account before they can play.

settings.label: No login before joining
settings.description: Turn off logging in with the server password before joining.

settings.label: Hardcore characters only
settings.description: Only hardcore characters can join.

settings.label: Mediumcore characters only
settings.description: Only mediumcore characters can join.

settings.label: Softcore characters only
settings.description: Only softcore characters can join.

settings.label: Kick on hardcore death
settings.description: Kick a hardcore player when they die.

settings.label: Ban on hardcore death
settings.description: Ban a hardcore player when they die.

settings.label: Spawn protection
settings.description: Stop players from building near the world spawn.

settings.label: Spawn protection radius
settings.description: How many tiles around spawn are protected.

settings.label: No building
settings.description: Nobody can place or break blocks.

settings.label: Remember where players left
settings.description: Put returning players back where they logged off.

settings.label: Group for new accounts
settings.description: The group new accounts are put in.

settings.label: Group for guests
settings.description: The group of players who are not logged in.

settings.label: Minimum password length
settings.description: The shortest password an account may have.

settings.label: Kick proxy users
settings.description: Kick players connecting through known proxies.

settings.label: Maximum enemies per player
settings.description: How many enemies can be near each player at once.

settings.label: Spawn delay
settings.description: Lower means enemies spawn more often. 600 is normal.

settings.label: Invasion size
settings.description: How much bigger invasions are than normal.

settings.label: Endless invasions
settings.description: Invasions started by command never end on their own.

settings.label: Hide who summoned bosses
settings.description: Do not name the player who started a boss fight or invasion.

settings.label: Statue enemies nearby
settings.description: Most enemies statues may spawn within 200 pixels.

settings.label: Statue enemies in range
settings.description: Most enemies statues may spawn within 600 pixels.

settings.label: Statue enemies in the world
settings.description: Most statue enemies in the whole world.

settings.label: PvP
settings.description: Whether players can fight each other.

settings.label: No invisibility in PvP
settings.description: Invisibility potions do not work during PvP.

settings.label: Most health
settings.description: Players with more health than this are disabled as cheaters.

settings.label: Most mana
settings.description: Players with more mana than this are disabled as cheaters.

settings.label: Respawn time
settings.description: Seconds before a dead player respawns. 0 uses the game's own timer.

settings.label: Respawn time during bosses
settings.description: Seconds before a player killed during a boss fight respawns. 0 uses the game's own timer.

settings.label: Server-side characters
settings.description: Keep each account's character on the server, so inventories can be seen here and players cannot bring items from other worlds.

settings.label: Starting health
settings.description: Health new characters start with.

settings.label: Starting mana
settings.description: Mana new characters start with.

settings.label: Save every (minutes)
settings.description: How often characters are saved.

settings.label: Keep player looks
settings.description: Players keep their own appearance instead of the saved one.

settings.label: Freeze infection spread
settings.description: Who may stop the Corruption, Crimson and Hallow from spreading with the Journey power.

settings.label: Freeze time
settings.description: Who may stop time with the Journey power.

settings.label: Time speed
settings.description: Who may speed time up.

settings.label: God mode
settings.description: Who may make themselves invincible.

settings.label: Enemy spawn rate
settings.description: Who may change how often enemies spawn.

settings.label: Difficulty slider
settings.description: Who may change the enemy difficulty.

settings.label: Freeze rain
settings.description: Who may stop the rain from changing.

settings.label: Freeze wind
settings.description: Who may stop the wind from changing.

settings.label: Longer reach
settings.description: Who may place blocks further away.

settings.label: Chat format
settings.description: How chat lines look. {1} group prefix, {2} name, {3} group suffix, {4} message.

settings.label: Chat above heads
settings.description: Show chat messages above players' heads.

settings.label: Longest chat message
settings.description: Messages longer than this are refused.

settings.label: Command prefix
settings.description: The character that starts a command.

settings.label: Autosave
settings.description: Save the world regularly.

settings.label: Announce saves
settings.description: Tell players when the world is saved.

settings.label: Backup every (minutes)
settings.description: How often a world backup is made. 0 turns backups off.

settings.label: Keep backups for (minutes)
settings.description: Backups older than this are deleted.

settings.label: Save on crash
settings.description: Try to save the world when the server crashes.

settings.label: Save when the last player leaves
settings.description: Save the world when the server empties.

settings.label: Cheat protection
settings.description: Extra checks against cheating clients.

settings.label: Enemy update rate
settings.description: Lower means less enemy skipping but more bandwidth. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: UPnP port forwarding
settings.description: Ask the router to forward the port. Not needed on a hosted server.

settings.label: Process priority
settings.description: How the system schedules the server.

settings.label: REST API
settings.description: TShock's web API. It needs its own port allocation to be reachable.

settings.label: REST API port
settings.description: The port of TShock's web API.

settings.label: Show countries
settings.description: Look up which country players connect from.

settings.label: Show IPs to admins
settings.description: Show players' IP addresses to admins when they join.
